Seeding Locations (UNDER CONSTRUCTION - spelling and grammar check)

Introduction

In this chapter we will take a closer look at how trajectory seeding (initilization) is done in TRACMASS. Two types of seeding are possible - from boxes defined in the namelist file and from seeding files. It is recomended to first try out seeding from the namelist file, to get an idea of how it works, before starting with the seeding files.

In these example we will be considering a case where only a single trajectory is initilized from each grid-cell (nqua=1 and partquant=1) and only the trajectories with positive flux (idir=1), forward in time (nff), and on meridional (isec=2) grid cell's face.

Seeding from namelist boxes

In this example, the namelist has set up seeding location as three boxes.

&INIT_SEEDING
     ! (1)  forward in time
     ! (-1) backward in time
     nff            = 1,
     
     ! (1) zonal cell's wall     
     ! (2) meridional cell's wall
     ! (3) vertical cell's wall
     isec           = 2,

     ! (1)  start when flux > 0
     ! (-1) start when flux < 0 
     idir           = 1,

     ! number of trajectories can be set by
     ! (1) constant number of particles in all seeding cells
     !     set by partQuant (particles / gridcell)
     ! (2) Each particle reflects mass transport at seeding.
     !     set by partQuant (m3/s or kg/s per particle)
     ! (3) Each particle reflects air/water mass/volume at seeding.
     !     set by partQuant in m3 or kg per particle
     nqua           = 1,
      
     ! (if nqua=1) particles/gridcell
     ! (if nqua=2) m3s-1/particle
     ! (if nqua=3) m3/particle
     partquant      = 1,

     ! (1) seed using ist,jst,kst (below)
     ! (2) seed using file with start positions
     seedtype       = 1,


     ! seed in box in range i = [ist1,ist2]
     !                      j = [jst1,jst2]
     !                      k = [kst1,kst2]

     !                box1,  box2,  box3
     ist1           = 285,   200,   400, 
     ist2           = 325,   250,   500,
     
     jst1           = 270,   150,   1,
     jst2           = 330,   170,   100,  
     
     kst1           = 1,     1,     10,
     kst2           = 1,     100,   20,  

     ! (1) seed only for specific times
     ! (2) seed using file with start positions
     seedtime       =  1, 

     ! (if seedtime=1) seed only between tst1 and tst2
     tst1           = 1,
     tst2           = 1,
/

Seeding from a file

A personal preference of the author is to keep the files relating to a simulation in the project's folder. In this case, my project is called global_model in which I have a folder called seed_dir with two files:

  • seed_condition.txt - contains the position, cell's wall and direction of the seeding trajectory
  • seed_time.txt - contains the time when trajectory seeding takes place
The setup of the namelist can be found in the code sample below.

Note:
The .txt extension has been tested and work for the model as seeding input files. Other formats, such as .csv, .nc, etc., might work as well. 
&INIT_SEEDING
     ! (1)  forward in time
     ! (-1) backward in time
     nff            = 1,
     
     ! (1) zonal cell's wall     
     ! (2) meridional cell's wall
     ! (3) vertical cell's wall
     isec           = 2,

     ! (1)  start when flux > 0
     ! (-1) start when flux < 0 
     idir           = 1,

     ! number of trajectories can be set by
     ! (1) constant number of particles in all seeding cells
     !     set by partQuant (particles / gridcell)
     ! (2) Each particle reflects mass transport at seeding.
     !     set by partQuant (m3/s or kg/s per particle)
     ! (3) Each particle reflects air/water mass/volume at seeding.
     !     set by partQuant in m3 or kg per particle
     nqua           = 1,

     ! (if nqua=1) particles/gridcell
     ! (if nqua=2) m3s-1/particle
     ! (if nqua=3) m3/particle
     partquant      = 1,

     ! (1) seed using ist,jst,kst (below)
     ! (2) seed using file with start positions
     seedtype       = 2,

     ! (if seedtype=2) directory of seed files
     seeddir        = 'projects/global_model/seed_dir/',
     
     ! (if seedtype=2) name of seed START CONDITION file
     seedfile       = 'seed_condition.txt',

     ! (1) seed only for specific times
     ! (2) seed using file with start positions
     seedtime       =  1, 

     ! (if seedtime = 2) name of seed TIME file
     timefile       = 'seed_time.txt',
/

File seed_condition.txt

The seeding file contains sets up the seeding condition with three parts:

  • 1st, 2nd, 3rd column - grid cell's location in the form of model index in x, y, and z direction
  • 4th collumn - which grid wall is used for seeding (isec)
  • 5th column - flux direction (idir)
For more information on the isec and idir parameters refer to the namelist documentation here. An example on how the seeding file is formatted is in the code snippet below.

! x_ind, y_ind, z_ind, isec, idir
  200,   250,   10,    1,    1,    ! First seeding condition
  200,   250,   10,    2,    1,    ! Second --//--
  200,   250,   10,    3,    1,    ! Third  --//--
   10,    12,    1,    1,    1,    ! Fourth --//--
   10,    12,    1,    1,   -1,    ! Fifth  --//--

File seed_time.txt

For the time file, there is only one column present and it determines in which global iterations (intrun) seeding should take place. The time steps need to be organized in a column, similarly to the seeding condition input file.
